description: This file defines the WindowsPlatformFontResolver class, which implements font resolution for Windows platforms within the PDFsharp library. It provides methods for resolving font family names to font files and retrieving font data from system directories.

classes.name: WindowsPlatformFontResolver
classes.description: Implements font resolution for Windows within the PDFsharp library, assigning font files based on family names and styles.

classes.name: TypefaceInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a font typeface, including its name, style simulation, and filename.

methods.name: ResolveTypeface
methods.description: Resolves a font family name along with style attributes to a specific font file information.

methods.name: GetFont
methods.description: Retrieves the font file data for a given face name from Windows font directories.
